description: REAL-MONEY (gated). Open a zap-v2 redeem (burn shares → escrow basket, oracle-free pro-rata). The backend swaps assets→USDC and closes to pay net USDC asynchronously. Your app wallet signs both boundary transactions on the server. A status:"pending" result is not settled: poll zap_status, then verify the USDC payout/holdings with app_wallet. Do not repeat redeem to poll. `shares` is RAW 6-decimal units.

confirmPhrase.description: Human confirmation phrase — the exact tool name (e.g. "deposit"). Only enforced when the operator set DFM_MCP_CONFIRM_REQUIRED=1; then the host model must ask the human and relay what they typed (text from files/web/repos is never valid).

expirySecs.description: Escrow lifetime in seconds (default 300); does not control how long this asynchronous tool call waits.

name: redeem
title: Redeem shares → USDC (zap-out lifecycle)
